Message.Name: NewOrderUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Submission of a new order to Cboe

Message.Name: NewOrderShortUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Submission of a new order to Cboe

Message.Name: CancelOrderUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Request to cancel a single order

Message.Name: PurgeOrdersUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Request to cancel a group of orders across all of the firm's sessions

Message.Name: ResetRiskUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Reset or release Firm, Symbol, or Risk Group ID level lockout conditions resulting from risk profile trips or self-imposed lockouts issued via Purge Orders messages

Message.Name: OrderAcknowledgementUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Acknowledgment messages are sent in response to New Order messages

Message.Name: OrderRejectedUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Rejected messages are sent in response to a New Order message which must be rejected

Message.Name: OrderModifiedUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Modified messages are sent in response to a Modify Request message to indicate that the order has been successfully modified

Message.Name: OrderRestatedUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Restated messages are sent to inform the Member that an order has been asynchronously modified for some reason without an explicit Modify Order message request having been sent

Message.Name: ModifyRejectedUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: User Modify Rejected messages are sent in response to a Modify Order message for an order which cannot be modified

Message.Name: OrderCancelledUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: This message indicates an order has been cancelled

Message.Name: CancelRejectedUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: A Cancel Rejected message is sent in response to a Cancel Order message to indicate that the cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: OrderExecutionUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: An Order Execution message is sent for each fill on an order

Message.Name: TradeCancelCorrectUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Used to relay a trade which has been cancelled (busted) or corrected (price change only)

Message.Name: PurgeRejectedUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: A Purge Rejected message is sent in response to a Purge Orders message to indicate that the mass cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: ResetRiskAcknowledgementUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Response to a Reset Risk message request

Message.Name: PurgeAcknowledgementUSEquitiesV1
Message.Description: A Purge Acknowledgment message is an unsequenced message sent when a Purge Orders message requesting an order purge has completed canceling all individual orders
